# The example collection: coverage and next steps

[Follow what is taught, what is adapted, and what still needs a chapter.]{.lesson-deck}
:::

There are 44 declared runnable example targets and
1 Quarto teaching chapters. The table includes older programs
that have not yet been converted. Target counts exclude test executables;
optional configurations can affect which targets a particular build enables.

## Spectral Methods in MATLAB

The [author's collection](https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/trefethen/spectral.html)
contains forty programs. Currently 1 have a corresponding lesson.
A link means that the lesson declares coverage of that experiment; the
scope column states changes in method or presentation. It does not mean
an unmodified MATLAB program was translated line for line. Pending rows
remain in the inventory while applicability and implementation are assessed.

| Program | Experiment | Lesson and scope |
|---:|---|---|
| [1](https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/trefethen/p1.m) | convergence of fourth-order finite differences | [Read the lesson](differentiation/periodic/index.qmd). Original fourth-order finite-difference resolution family, with additional FD2 and FFT comparisons. |
| [2](https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/trefethen/p2.m) | convergence of periodic spectral method (compare p1.m) | Pending assessment and implementation. |

## Capability coverage

The machine-readable [coverage inventory](coverage.json) also tracks capability families.
These links identify focused introductory lessons, not complete API coverage:
a heat propagator does not demonstrate every exponential integrator, and a
fixed-step restart does not establish an adaptive restart contract.

| Capability family | Current teaching chapters |
|---|---|
| geometry | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| distributed fields and MPI | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| local and distributed FFT | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| finite differences and spectral gradients | [periodic](differentiation/periodic/index.qmd) |
| conservative fluxes and nonperiodic boundaries | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| fixed and adaptive integration | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| multi-field runtime integration | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| exponential and adaptive ETD | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| initial conditions and modifiers | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| JSON/TOML validation and application sessions | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| field output and visualization | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| checkpoints and restart | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| Krylov and nonlinear solves | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| geometric multigrid | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| microelasticity and homogenization | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| coupling and transactional attempts | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| profiling and communication diagnostics | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| CUDA and HIP execution | Pending a teaching chapter. |
| nonlinear models and incompressible flow | Pending a teaching chapter. |

Every family needs an actual model, a useful mathematical story and appropriate runtime evidence.
